title: Control Strategies for Multi-Species Wasserstein Gradient Flows
summary: We stabilize stationary states of coupled multi-species McKean--Vlasov equations by feedback control, extending a spectral approach based on the Wasserstein Hessian and a Riccati equation from a single density to a product of Wasserstein spaces. We give necessary and sufficient conditions for local exponential stabilization at a prescribed rate when only one species is actuated, together with the minimum number of control inputs required.
